tools.name: search_tools
tools.description: Search open-source AI agent tools (frameworks, coding agents, memory, RAG, observability, MCP servers...) ranked by GitHub activity. Returns stars, 30-day star growth, capabilities and alternatives.

tools.name: get_tool
tools.description: Get details for one tool by slug (from search_tools): GitHub stats, capabilities, best-for, limitations, alternatives.

tools.name: get_alternatives
tools.description: List open-source alternatives to a tool, with GitHub stats for each, to compare options.

tools.name: submit_tool
tools.description: List an AI agent tool (framework, coding agent, MCP server, memory/RAG, evals, browser agent...) on AgentoolRank for free. The free listing is queued; the response lists every paid option (price, days to go live, checkout_url for your human to pay) and recommends the cheapest one that fits max_budge

tools.name: get_submission_status
tools.description: Check review status of a submission (pending/approved/rejected, queue position, listing URL).

tools.name: recommend_directories
tools.description: Which launch directories should a product be submitted to? Returns sites our own products actually went through, each tagged auto / manual (needs one human step) with free-tier conditions, measured link type, login, human-only steps, form tips and the success signal to look for, plus one checklist o

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_submission_status · Public sink: submit_tool, recommend_directories.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_submission_status · Public sink: submit_tool, recommend_directories

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

labels.name: report_result
labels.description: [Launch directories] Use this when recording an outcome for a domain issued by next_directory, not submitting a tool to AgentoolRank. Requires the same Submit Kit key, that domain and status: submitted, listed, rejected, failed or skipped; listing_url and note are optional. Records the outcome and c

labels.name: my_progress
labels.description: [Launch directories] Use this after report_result or to resume a session; requires the Submit Kit key. Returns product_type, cap, sites, progress_page and counts: issued (total handed out), unreported, submitted, listed_reported, rejected, failed and skipped. Outstanding sites have status 'issued' i

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_alternatives, get_submission_status · Private data: report_result · Public sink: submit_tool, recommend_directories, next_directory, report_result, my_progress.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_alternatives, get_submission_status · Private data: report_result · Public sink: submit_tool, recommend_directories, next_directory, report_result, my_progress

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_tools" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Search open-source AI agent tools (frameworks, coding agents, memory, RAG, observability, MCP servers...) ranked by GitHub activity. Returns stars, 30-day star growth, capabilities and alternatives." → after: "[Tool directory] Search open-source AI agent tools (frameworks, coding agents, memory, RAG, observability, MCP servers) ranked by GitHub activity. Returns stars, 30-day star growth, capabilities and alternatives."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
